description: AI Strategy Optimizer - A parameter optimization engine for the general StrategyLibrary strategies. Unlike TradeProOptimizer which optimizes TradePro-specific configs, this engine optimizes the backtest execution parameters (risk percent, stop multiplier, take-profit ratio) and identifies the optimal timeframe/symbol combinations for each strategy. Uses grid search with walk-forward validation to prevent overfitting.
steps: Create app/src/main/java/com/foxtrader/app/domain/usecase/ai/AiStrategyOptimizer.kt - a @Singleton class with @Inject constructor taking BacktestEngine and BacktestAnalyticsEngine. Optimizes BacktestConfig parameters (riskPercent grid: 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0; spread variants; slippage variants) for a given StrategyFunction against candle data.

Create data classes: OptimizationGrid (riskPercentValues, spreadValues, slippageValues), OptimizationCandidate (config: BacktestConfig, backtestResult, analyticsReport, compositeScore, qualified boolean based on minimum trade count), AiOptimizationReport (symbol, timeframe, strategyName, candidates ranked by score, bestCandidate, bestOutOfSample BacktestResult?, trainBars, testBars, narrative, overfitWarning boolean).
Implement in-sample/out-of-sample split (70/30 default). Train on in-sample, validate winner on out-of-sample. Flag overfitting if out-of-sample profit factor < 0.5 * in-sample profit factor.
Composite scoring: 40% profit factor (capped at 5.0), 25% Sharpe ratio, 20% win rate, 15% max drawdown (inverted - lower is better). Minimum 5 trades to qualify.

Create app/src/test/java/com/foxtrader/app/domain/usecase/ai/AiStrategyOptimizerTest.kt - JUnit4 tests: optimizer produces ranked candidates, best candidate has highest score, overfitting is flagged when out-of-sample degrades significantly, insufficient data returns empty report, minimum trade count filter works correctly.
acceptance_criteria: AiStrategyOptimizer compiles with no android.* imports
Tests validate scoring, ranking, overfitting detection, and graceful degradation
Optimizer uses walk-forward split to honestly validate parameters
Report includes clear overfit warning when out-of-sample performance degrades
verification: CI runs ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest and all new tests in AiStrategyOptimizerTest pass
CI runs ./gradlew compileDebugKotlin and new source compiles without errors
